items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He asked me would I go with the band, and I said yes, a thousand times.

ctx.x: You were already finished with high school?

Yeah, I was still in high school. Whoever called me, I was there. Now, Johnny Otis had the band at the Club Alabam and that was his steady gig. We had been there for months, years or something. Then, he finally was able to put together some jobs back east, but some of the guys in the band didn’t want to travel, so that was my chance. He asked me would I go with the band, and I said yes, a thousand times. The first place we came to was Chicago, and we had a booking for ten weeks at a place called the El Grotto in…
